subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- August 30, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - August 30, 2026**

**Debian Votes to Allow "Responsible Use of Generative AI"**

In a significant development, the Debian project has voted to allow the "responsible use of generative AI" in the Debian community. This decision reflects the growing recognition of the potential benefits and challenges of AI in the open-source ecosystem. As AcreetionOS is built on top of Arch Linux, which is a derivative of Debian, this development may have implications for our project. We will continue to monitor this situation and assess any potential impact on our community.

**Community News**

* The AcreetionOS community has been actively engaged in discussions on our Discord server, with many users sharing their experiences and feedback on the latest release.
* We are excited to announce that our community member, @cobra3282000, has made significant contributions to the Calamares installer, including fixing a geocode-glib update conflict and configuring Secret Detection and SAST in our GitLab CI/CD pipeline.

**Practical Tip**

If you're experiencing issues with your AcreetionOS installation, try running the following command in the terminal: `sudo pacman -Syyu`. This will update your package list and ensure that your system is up-to-date. If the issue persists, feel free to reach out to our community support channel on Discord for further assistance.

Stay tuned for more updates from the AcreetionOS community!
